summary: Diffuse bilateral coarse patchy opacities on the prior image are less prominent on the current image, which shows clearer aeration.

findings.rationale: Prior image shows diffuse coarse patchy/reticular opacity bilaterally, most pronounced in the mid-to-lower zones; current image, matched by rib and hilar landmarks despite a slightly more oblique current projection, shows both lungs better aerated with more distinct vessels and less patchy haze.
